verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a concrete catalog-feed pathway (Store Sync's Google Product Feed / OpenAI ACP Product Feed with required fields, CSV/TSV/PSV, size limits) plus partner-based catalog onramps (Wix, Cymbio, BigCommerce/Feedonomics, Shopware), which directly matches the story. However, access is form-gated (not self-serve), Store Sync is scoped only to US physical goods in USD, and eligibility requires an existing PayPal/Braintree merchant setup, all of which are significant caveats. Missing for 10: self-serve onboarding, broader product-type/geography coverage, and independent/hands-on confirmation the feed import actually surfaces products in live agent surfaces.
